passages.text: When the whole nation had finished crossing the Jordan, the LORD said to Joshua, “Choose twelve men from among the people, one from each tribe, and command them: ‘Take up for yourselves twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan where the priests were standing, carry them with you, and set them down in the place where you spend the night.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The Israelites finished crossing the Jordan River.
The LORD spoke to Joshua.
The LORD gave Joshua instructions.
The LORD told Joshua to choose twelve men from the people.
Joshua must choose one man from each tribe.
The LORD told Joshua to command these men.
The men must take twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan River.
The stones must come from the place where the priests stood.
The men must carry the stones with them.
The men must set the stones down at the place where they will stay that night.
passages.original: וַיְהִי֙ כַּאֲשֶׁר־ תַּ֣מּוּ כָל־ הַגּ֔וֹי לַעֲב֖וֹר אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן פ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ לֵאמֹֽר׃ קְח֤וּ לָכֶם֙ מִן־ הָעָ֔ם שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר אֲנָשִׁ֑ים אִישׁ־ אֶחָ֥ד אִישׁ־ אֶחָ֖ד מִשָּֽׁבֶט׃ וְצַוּ֣וּ אוֹתָם֮ לֵאמֹר֒ שְׂאֽוּ־ לָכֶ֨ם מִזֶּ֜ה מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּ֗ן מִמַּצַּב֙ רַגְלֵ֣י הַכֹּהֲנִ֔ים הָכִ֖ין שְׁתֵּים־ עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה אֲבָנִ֑ים וְהַעֲבַרְתֶּ֤ם אוֹתָם֙ עִמָּכֶ֔ם וְהִנַּחְתֶּ֣ם אוֹתָ֔ם בַּמָּל֕וֹן אֲשֶׁר־ תָּלִ֥ינוּ ב֖וֹ הַלָּֽיְלָה׃ס

passages.text: So Joshua summoned the twelve men he had appointed from the Israelites, one from each tribe, and said to them, “Cross over before the ark of the LORD your God into the middle of the Jordan. Each of you is to take a stone upon his shoulder, according to the number of the tribes of Israel, to serve as a sign among you. In the future, when your children ask, ‘What do these stones mean to you?’
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of the Israelites.
He had chosen twelve men from the people of Israel.
He chose one man from each tribe.
Joshua called these twelve men.
He spoke to them.
He said, “Go ahead of the ark of the LORD your God.
Go into the middle of the Jordan River.
Each man must pick up one stone.
Carry the stone on your shoulder.
There must be one stone for each tribe of Israel.
These stones will be a sign among you.
In the future, your children will ask you a question.
They will say, ‘What do these stones mean to you?’”
passages.original: וַיִּקְרָ֣א יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ אֶל־ שְׁנֵ֤ים הֶֽעָשָׂר֙ אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵכִ֖ין מִבְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִישׁ־ אֶחָ֥ד אִישׁ־ אֶחָ֖ד מִשָּֽׁבֶט׃ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָהֶם֙ יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ עִ֠בְרוּ לִפְנֵ֨י אֲר֧וֹן יְהוָ֛ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֖ם אֶל־ תּ֣וֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְהָרִ֨ימוּ לָכֶ֜ם אִ֣ישׁ אֶ֤בֶן אַחַת֙ עַל־ שִׁכְמ֔וֹ לְמִסְפַּ֖ר שִׁבְטֵ֥י בְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ לְמַ֗עַן תִּֽהְיֶ֛ה זֹ֥את א֖וֹת בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֑ם כִּֽי־ יִשְׁאָל֨וּן בְּנֵיכֶ֤ם מָחָר֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר מָ֛ה הָאֲבָנִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: you are to tell them, ‘The waters of the Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the LORD. When it crossed the Jordan, the waters were cut off.’ Therefore these stones will be a memorial to the Israelites forever.”
passages.sermon:
The Israelites crossed the Jordan River.
The priests carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
The ark of the covenant is a holy object.
The LORD gave the ark to Israel as a sign of His presence.
When the ark entered the Jordan River, the waters stopped flowing.
The waters of the Jordan were cut off because of the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
The ark crossed the river.
The waters remained cut off while the ark was in the river.
The people took twelve stones from the river.
These stones are a memorial for the Israelites.
The stones remind Israel of what God did at the Jordan.
The stones will be a memorial forever.
passages.original: וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֣ם לָהֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִכְרְת֜וּ מֵימֵ֤י הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ מִפְּנֵי֙ אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָ֔ה בְּעָבְרוֹ֙ בַּיַּרְדֵּ֔ן נִכְרְת֖וּ מֵ֣י הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְ֠הָיוּ הָאֲבָנִ֨ים הָאֵ֧לֶּה לְזִכָּר֛וֹן לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: Thus the Israelites did as Joshua had commanded them. They took up twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan, one for each tribe of Israel, just as the LORD had told Joshua; and they carried them to the camp, where they set them down.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites obeyed Joshua.
Joshua was the leader of the Israelites.
The Israelites did what Joshua commanded.
They took twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan River.
There was one stone for each tribe of Israel.
The LORD had told Joshua to do this.
The Israelites carried the stones with them to their camp.
They set the stones down at the camp.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ־ כֵ֣ן בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֘ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֣ה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ֒ וַיִּשְׂא֡וּ שְׁתֵּֽי־ עֶשְׂרֵ֨ה אֲבָנִ֜ים מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּ֗ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ לְמִסְפַּ֖ר שִׁבְטֵ֣י בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיַּעֲבִר֤וּם עִמָּם֙ אֶל־ הַמָּל֔וֹן וַיַּנִּח֖וּם שָֽׁם׃

passages.text: Joshua also set up twelve stones in the middle of the Jordan, in the place where the priests who carried the ark of the covenant stood. And the stones are there to this day.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua set up twelve stones.
He placed the stones in the middle of the Jordan River.
The priests carried the ark of the covenant.
The priests stood in the river.
Joshua put the stones where the priests stood.
The stones remain there to this day.
passages.original: וּשְׁתֵּ֧ים עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה אֲבָנִ֗ים הֵקִ֣ים יְהוֹשֻׁעַ֮ בְּת֣וֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן֒ תַּ֗חַת מַצַּב֙ רַגְלֵ֣י הַכֹּהֲנִ֔ים נֹשְׂאֵ֖י אֲר֣וֹן הַבְּרִ֑ית וַיִּ֣הְיוּ שָׁ֔ם עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: Now the priests who carried the ark remained standing in the middle of the Jordan until the people had completed everything the LORD had commanded Joshua to tell them, just as Moses had directed Joshua. The people hurried across, and after everyone had finished crossing, the priests with the ark of the LORD crossed in the sight of the people.
passages.sermon:
The priests carried the ark of the covenant.
The priests stood in the middle of the Jordan River.
They stayed there until the people finished everything.
The LORD had commanded Joshua to speak to the people.
Moses had also commanded Joshua.
The people hurried across the river.
All the people finished crossing.
Then the priests crossed the river.
The priests carried the ark of the LORD.
They crossed in front of the people.
passages.original: וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֞ים נֹשְׂאֵ֣י הָאָר֗וֹן עֹמְדִים֮ בְּת֣וֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן֒ עַ֣ד תֹּ֣ם כָּֽל־ הַ֠דָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֤ה אֶת־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ לְדַבֵּ֣ר אֶל־ הָעָ֔ם כְּכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֥ה מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶת־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ וַיְמַהֲר֥וּ הָעָ֖ם וַֽיַּעֲבֹֽרוּ׃ וַיְהִ֛י כַּֽאֲשֶׁר־ תַּ֥ם כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם לַֽעֲב֑וֹר וַיַּעֲבֹ֧ר אֲרוֹן־ יְהוָ֛ה וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֥י הָעָֽם׃

passages.text: The Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh crossed over before the Israelites, armed for battle as Moses had instructed them.
passages.sermon:
The Reubenites crossed over the Jordan River.
The Gadites crossed over the Jordan River.
Half the tribe of Manasseh crossed over the Jordan River.
They went before the rest of the Israelites.
They were armed for battle.
Moses had instructed them to do this.
passages.original: וַ֠יַּעַבְרוּ בְּנֵי־ רְאוּבֵ֨ן וּבְנֵי־ גָ֜ד וַחֲצִ֨י שֵׁ֤בֶט הַֽמְנַשֶּׁה֙ חֲמֻשִׁ֔ים לִפְנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מֹשֶֽׁה׃

passages.text: About 40,000 troops armed for battle crossed over before the LORD into the plains of Jericho.
passages.sermon:
About 40,000 men prepared for war.
These men were soldiers.
They crossed over before the LORD.
They went into the plains of Jericho.
passages.original: כְּאַרְבָּעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף חֲלוּצֵ֣י הַצָּבָ֑א עָבְר֞וּ לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה אֶ֖ל עַֽרְב֥וֹת יְרִיחֽוֹ׃ס

passages.text: On that day the LORD exalted Joshua in the sight of all Israel, and they revered him all the days of his life, just as they had revered Moses.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
Joshua was the leader of Israel after Moses.
On that day, the LORD made Joshua great.
All the people of Israel saw this.
They honored Joshua.
They respected Joshua all his life.
They honored him just as they had honored Moses.
passages.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא גִּדַּ֤ל יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ בְּעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּֽרְא֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יָרְא֥וּ אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה כָּל־ יְמֵ֥י חַיָּֽיו׃פ

passages.text: Then the LORD said to Joshua, “Command the priests who carry the ark of the Testimony to come up from the Jordan.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Joshua.
The LORD gave Joshua a command.
The LORD said, “Command the priests.”
These priests carry the ark of the Testimony.
Tell the priests to come up from the Jordan River.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ לֵאמֹֽר׃ צַוֵּה֙ אֶת־ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים נֹשְׂאֵ֖י אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵד֑וּת וְיַעֲל֖וּ מִן־ הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃

passages.text: So Joshua commanded the priests, “Come up from the Jordan.”
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
God had exalted Joshua in the eyes of all Israel.
Joshua spoke to the priests.
The priests were carrying the ark of the covenant.
Joshua gave a command to the priests.
He said, “Come up from the Jordan.”
passages.original: וַיְצַ֣ו יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ אֶת־ הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים לֵאמֹ֑ר עֲל֖וּ מִן־ הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃

passages.text: When the priests carrying the ark of the covenant of the LORD came up out of the Jordan and their feet touched the dry land, the waters of the Jordan returned to their course and overflowed all the banks as before.
passages.sermon:
The priests carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
They came up out of the Jordan River.
Their feet touched the dry land.
The waters of the Jordan returned to their place.
The waters flowed as before.
The waters covered all the banks of the river.
passages.original: וַ֠יְהִי בַּעֲלוֹת הַכֹּהֲנִ֜ים נֹשְׂאֵ֨י אֲר֤וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָה֙ מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן נִתְּק֗וּ כַּפּוֹת֙ רַגְלֵ֣י הַכֹּהֲנִ֔ים אֶ֖ל הֶחָרָבָ֑ה וַיָּשֻׁ֤בוּ מֵֽי־ הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ לִמְקוֹמָ֔ם וַיֵּלְכ֥וּ כִתְמוֹל־ שִׁלְשׁ֖וֹם עַל־ כָּל־ גְּדוֹתָֽיו׃

passages.text: On the tenth day of the first month the people went up from the Jordan and camped at Gilgal on the eastern border of Jericho.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel crossed the Jordan River.
They did this on the tenth day of the first month.
They set up camp at Gilgal.
Gilgal is on the eastern border of Jericho.
passages.original: וְהָעָ֗ם עָלוּ֙ מִן־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן בֶּעָשׂ֖וֹר לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֑וֹן וַֽיַּחֲנוּ֙ בַּגִּלְגָּ֔ל בִּקְצֵ֖ה מִזְרַ֥ח יְרִיחֽוֹ׃

passages.text: And there at Gilgal Joshua set up the twelve stones they had taken from the Jordan.
passages.sermon: Joshua was the leader of Israel.\r\nJoshua took twelve stones from the Jordan River.\r\nJoshua set up these twelve stones at Gilgal.
passages.original: וְאֵת֩ שְׁתֵּ֨ים עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה הָֽאֲבָנִים֙ הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָקְח֖וּ מִן־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן הֵקִ֥ים יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בַּגִּלְגָּֽל׃

passages.text: Then Joshua said to the Israelites, “In the future, when your children ask their fathers, ‘What is the meaning of these stones?’
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
\r\nJoshua spoke to the Israelites.
\r\nJoshua said, “In the future, your children will ask their fathers about these stones.
\r\nThey will say, ‘What do these stones mean?’”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֛אמֶר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר אֲשֶׁר֩ יִשְׁאָל֨וּן בְּנֵיכֶ֤ם מָחָר֙ אֶת־ אֲבוֹתָ֣ם לֵאמֹ֔ר מָ֖ה הָאֲבָנִ֥ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

passages.text: you are to tell them, ‘Israel crossed the Jordan on dry ground.’
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
\r\nGod chose Joshua to lead the Israelites.
\r\nGod commanded Joshua to set up twelve stones at Gilgal.
\r\nThe Israelites took these stones from the Jordan River.
\r\nJoshua told the Israelites to teach their children.
\r\nHe said, "Tell your children this."
\r\n"Israel crossed this Jordan River on dry ground."
\r\nGod made the ground dry so Israel could cross.
\r\nGod showed His power to Israel and to all people.
passages.original: וְהוֹדַעְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־ בְּנֵיכֶ֣ם לֵאמֹ֑ר בַּיַּבָּשָׁה֙ עָבַ֣ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: For the LORD your God dried up the waters of the Jordan before you until you had crossed over, just as He did to the Red Sea, which He dried up before us until we had crossed over.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD dried up the waters of the Jordan River before you.
He did this so you could cross over.
The LORD did the same thing at the Red Sea.
He dried up the Red Sea before us.
We crossed over on dry ground.
passages.original: אֲשֶׁר־ הוֹבִישׁ֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֜ם אֶת־ מֵ֧י הַיַּרְדֵּ֛ן מִפְּנֵיכֶ֖ם עַֽד־ עָבְרְכֶ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂה֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֧ם לְיַם־ ס֛וּף אֲשֶׁר־ הוֹבִ֥ישׁ מִפָּנֵ֖ינוּ עַד־ עָבְרֵֽנוּ׃

passages.text: He did this so that all the peoples of the earth may know that the hand of the LORD is mighty, and so that you may always fear the LORD your God.”
passages.sermon:
God acted with power.
He did this so everyone on earth would know Him.
He wanted all people to see that His hand is strong.
He wanted you to fear the LORD your God.
He wanted you to respect Him all your days.
passages.original: לְ֠מַעַן דַּ֜עַת כָּל־ עַמֵּ֤י הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ אֶת־ יַ֣ד יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י חֲזָקָ֖ה הִ֑יא לְמַ֧עַן יְרָאתֶ֛ם אֶת־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃ס
